content_trends.implication_for_gr: Kto napise otazky, podla ktorych klient vybera, urcuje kriteria sutaze. GR potrebuje vlastnu uprimnu verziu s hranicami (W33-03).

content_trends.evidence: Ciklum AI Strategy Clinic + 90-day roadmap + novy MCP e-book (3.8.); STRV three-layer + RODES; SudoLabs Spec-Driven Development; Vacuumlabs 9 gated whitepaperov + 'Spark'
content_trends.implication_for_gr: GR nema pojmenovany citovatelny asset ani produktizovane CTA.
